SUBMITTED.title: Report sent
SUBMITTED.means: Your report reached the cyber cell. The clock on the bank request starts now.
SUBMITTED.do: Nothing. Keep your reference number somewhere you can find it.

RECEIVED_BY_UNIT.title: Received by the unit
RECEIVED_BY_UNIT.means: A person has it in their queue. It is not sitting in a system waiting to be noticed.

ASSIGNED.title: Assigned to an officer
ASSIGNED.means: A named officer is handling it.
ASSIGNED.do: You can call the desk number on your report and quote your reference.

NEEDS_INFO.title: They need one more thing
NEEDS_INFO.means: The officer cannot go further without one specific thing. It is always named.
NEEDS_INFO.do: Add the item they asked for. This is the only thing holding the case up.

ACTION_TAKEN:LIEN_REQUESTED.title: Hold requested from the bank
ACTION_TAKEN:LIEN_REQUESTED.means: Police have asked your bank to hold the money. The bank decides, not the police and not us.
ACTION_TAKEN:LIEN_REQUESTED.do: Nothing. Most banks reply within a day or two, and you get an SMS either way.

ACTION_TAKEN:TAKEDOWN_REQUESTED.title: Takedown requested from the platform
ACTION_TAKEN:TAKEDOWN_REQUESTED.means: Police have asked the platform to remove the content.
ACTION_TAKEN:TAKEDOWN_REQUESTED.do: Do not contact the poster yourself. Save any new copies you find.

ACTION_TAKEN:NOTICE_ISSUED.title: Notice issued
ACTION_TAKEN:NOTICE_ISSUED.means: A formal notice has gone to the person or company involved.

ACTION_TAKEN:SUSPECT_TRACED.title: Account traced
ACTION_TAKEN:SUSPECT_TRACED.means: The account or person that received your money has been identified.
ACTION_TAKEN:SUSPECT_TRACED.do: Nothing. Your officer will tell you if a statement is needed.

FIR_REGISTERED.title: FIR registered
FIR_REGISTERED.means: A formal police case exists. An FIR is what lets police compel banks and platforms.
FIR_REGISTERED.do: Keep the FIR number with your reference number.

CLOSED.title: Closed
CLOSED.means: The case is finished. The outcome is stated plainly, good or bad.
CLOSED.do: If you disagree, the escalation ladder on your report still works.

WITHDRAWN.title: Withdrawn
WITHDRAWN.means: You asked for this report to be withdrawn.
WITHDRAWN.do: Nothing. You can file again at any time.
